requirements.title: F# application stack
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Use F# for domain, API, and WebAssembly frontend; Limen runtime and Forma components, Folio optional.

requirements.title: Server-only private data access
requirements.acceptance_criterion: All private GitHub data accessed through an authenticated F# server; no private repo credentials in the WASM client.

requirements.title: Single canonical contact source
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Preserve canonical private contact JSON v1.1.0; derived people/source files remain consistent after writes.

requirements.title: Minimal persistence
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Store saved list JSON in private holiday-list repository with revision-controlled commits; no database required for MVP.

requirements.title: Verified dependencies
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Pin verified Limen/Forma compatible versions and use working architecture, not unverified placeholder components.

requirements.title: Safe idempotent operations
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Create/update/finalize operations are resilient to network retries and preserve stable identifiers.

requirements.title: Guest 1 separately editable
requirements.acceptance_criterion: New contact has independently persisted nonblank Guest 1, both frontend and domain.

requirements.title: Guest 2 separately editable and optional
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Guest 2 is separate, nullable, editable and does not overwrite Guest 1.

requirements.title: Named people never dropped
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Preserve every named person and separately stored original name, including other/additional guests.

requirements.title: Contact add and edit
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Owner can create and edit guest names, surname, recipient, household, notes, and structured address while preserving immutable ID.

requirements.title: Explicit missing fields
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Address fields allow explicit null; missing_fields records every missing property.

requirements.title: Review incomplete addresses
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Contact saves with incomplete mailing details but never silently gains mail-ready/verified status.

requirements.title: Postal code stays text
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No numeric coercion, supports leading zeros and ZIP+4.

requirements.title: Soft-delete contact
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Mark inactive using is_deleted, deleted_at, deleted_by, deletion_reason; never remove master row.

requirements.title: Restore contact
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Restore inactive contact while retaining Git commit history and original data.

requirements.title: No cascading history deletion
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Contact soft-deletion retains people and source records, and never rewrites old holiday-list snapshots.

requirements.title: Duplicate candidate review
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Flag same address/similar name for review without silently merging different recipients.

requirements.title: Optimistic contact concurrency
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Reject stale edits with visible conflict and no silent last-write-wins.

requirements.title: Additional named people represented
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Preserve additional names in contact and saved-list snapshot, not only Guest 1 and Guest 2.

requirements.title: Create holiday list with metadata
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Provide title/year/occasion/notes and stable list ID, with draft status.

requirements.title: Select active contacts
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Search/filter/include active contact households, no duplicate contact ID in a list.

requirements.title: List inclusion independent of contacts
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Include/exclude or remove from draft changes list only, not master contact or its soft-delete flag.

requirements.title: Persist draft
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Selections, copied names/addresses, notes, and status survive reload and restart.

requirements.title: Finalize immutable snapshot
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Freeze finalized list values, prohibit edits to finalized version.

requirements.title: Source edits cannot rewrite history
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Final list never picks up later contact changes, including name or address.

requirements.title: Historical soft-delete independence
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Old saved list remains available when a linked contact later becomes deleted.

requirements.title: New revision from finalized
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Copy old final into new editable revision, retain immutable old file.

requirements.title: Archive list without physical deletion
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Archived list hidden in active index but visible via archive filter.

requirements.title: Idempotent create and finalize
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Retries do not create duplicate list IDs, entries or final versions.

requirements.title: Named people in snapshots
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Retain additional named people in list snapshot even if not in the two guest CSV columns.

requirements.title: Export selected holiday list
requirements.acceptance_criterion: CSV export includes only included list entries, one row per contact, generated on explicit owner request.

requirements.title: Separate guest columns
requirements.acceptance_criterion: CSV fixed header includes Contact ID, Guest 1, Guest 2, Card Recipient, Additional Names / Household, Address Line 1, Address Line 2, City, State, Postal Code, Country.

requirements.title: Missing address export modes
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Explicit mail-ready-only skip vs all-included with blanks/warnings; no silent omissions.

requirements.title: Lossless CSV quoting and postal
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Correct quoting, UTF-8, line breaks, commas, and leading zero ZIP codes.

requirements.title: Spreadsheet-safe export
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Neutralize formula-like cell inputs in exported CSV while original JSON remains unchanged.

requirements.title: Export saved snapshot not live contact
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Historical export uses stored list values and does not mutate draft/finalized list.

requirements.title: Authenticated all private routes
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Server authorization for contact/list/history/export and soft-delete/restore endpoints; no anonymous personal data.

requirements.title: No PII in public app assets
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No source records, names, addresses, tokens, or exports in public repo, build, Pages, fixtures or logs.

requirements.title: Concurrent update protection
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Compare-and-swap commit revision semantics, 409 on conflicts, no lost update.

requirements.title: Canonical write consistency
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Master and its projections remain consistent after successful or interrupted commits.

requirements.title: Least-privilege backend authorization
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Server restriction to private repo/path and authorizes operations independently of browser UI.

requirements.title: Safe migration from current data
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Read-modify-write source schema v1.1.0 without dropping existing names, people, source IDs, or null fields.

requirements.title: Private response caching restrictions
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No public storage or permanent localStorage authority for personal data; private responses no-store.

requirements.title: Mobile-first screens
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Contacts, forms, list editor, and export function on phone-sized viewports without horizontal overflow.

requirements.title: Complete navigation and state
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Dashboard, contacts, details, edit, new list, draft, historical list, export with correct status feedback.

requirements.title: Accessible interactions
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Keyboard operation, visible focus, accessible controls, labeled Guest 1 and Guest 2, announced errors.

requirements.title: Honest loading and failure states
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Loading, empty, offline, forbidden, stale edit, and save errors never show false success.

requirements.title: Forma layout resilience
requirements.acceptance_criterion: No clipping on long names, addresses, 150 percent text scale or rounded containers.

requirements.title: Verified gates and traceability
requirements.acceptance_criterion: Every requirement has an acceptance test, evidence and status; no NOT_RUN reported as PASS.
